sources.batch_size: configs/train/clip_esm.json batch_size; per optimizer step on one GPU
sources.accumulate_grad_batches: configs/train/clip_esm.json has 2 on 4 GPUs (8 x 4 x 2 = 64); clipzyme.pdf App. D batch size 64; one GPU needs 8 to reach 64
sources.precision: configs/train/clip_esm.json precision; clipzyme.pdf App. D bfloat16
sources.max_epochs: configs/train/clip_esm.json max_epochs; clipzyme.pdf App. D says about 30 epochs (code wins)

sources.weight_decay: clipzyme.pdf App. D; not set in configs/train/clip_esm.json (code default 0); other released configs set 0.05

sources.warmup_steps: configs/train/clip_esm.json warmup_steps; clipzyme.pdf App. D (the scheduler steps once per epoch, see REPORT open issues)
sources.monitor: configs/train/clip_esm.json monitor; best model = best validation clip_quantile
sources.assign_splits: EMULaToR splits are used as they are

sources.frozen_hparams: used instead of the same keys of hparams with --frozen_esm; every other key of configs/train/clip_esm_frozen.json equals hparams, except the unused from_checkpoint and cache_path. clip_freeze_esm, max_epochs: clip_esm_frozen.json. batch_size, accumulate_grad_batches, virtual_gpus: clip_esm_frozen.json has 8 per GPU x 4 GPUs x accumulate 1 = 32 per optimizer step, with clip_loss_use_gather. In contrastive.py each GPU contrasts its 8 local rows against all 32 gathered features, and concat_all_gather carries no gradient, so the gathered features are constants; DDP then averages the 4 gradients. One GPU loads the 32 samples of a step, encodes the reactions in virtual_gpus ranks of 8, and the loss (virtual_ranks.py) uses constant gathered features and the mean of the per-rank losses. virtual_gpus is not a main.py argument; train.py passes it as EMULATOR_VIRTUAL_GPUS. weight_decay: not set in clip_esm_frozen.json, so the code default 0 (hparams has 0.05 from clipzyme.pdf App. D). lr is the same in both because the scheduler overwrites it
